准备美国外企面试，不知道该从哪里开始？这 10 道题几乎覆盖了面试最常见的考察方向：自我介绍、优缺点、求职动机、岗位匹配度、行为面试和薪资预期等。 问题和英文回答思路都整理在图片里了，建议每道题都提前准备一个 60—90 秒的答案，并搭配真实案例。尤其是行为类问题，可以用 STAR 法梳理；谈期望薪资时，也别急着先报底价，要结合职位公开区间、个人经验和整体福利综合判断。 面试不是背模板，而是提前整理好自己的“故事库”。 建议把这组图片收藏下来，面试前快速过一遍，回答会更自然、更有逻辑🌟 [#美国求职](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E7%25BE%258E%25E5%259B%25BD%25E6%25B1%2582%25E8%2581%258C&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#美国找工作](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E7%25BE%258E%25E5%259B%25BD%25E6%2589%25BE%25E5%25B7%25A5%25E4%25BD%259C&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#外企面试](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E5%25A4%2596%25E4%25BC%2581%25E9%259D%25A2%25E8%25AF%2595&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#英文面试](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E8%258B%25B1%25E6%2596%2587%25E9%259D%25A2%25E8%25AF%2595&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#面试高频题](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E9%259D%25A2%25E8%25AF%2595%25E9%25AB%2598%25E9%25A2%2591%25E9%25A2%2598&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#面试技巧](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E9%259D%25A2%25E8%25AF%2595%25E6%258A%2580%25E5%25B7%25A7&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#求职干货](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E6%25B1%2582%25E8%2581%258C%25E5%25B9%25B2%25E8%25B4%25A7&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#纽约求职](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E7%25BA%25BD%25E7%25BA%25A6%25E6%25B1%2582%25E8%2581%258C&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#海外求职](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E6%25B5%25B7%25E5%25A4%2596%25E6%25B1%2582%25E8%2581%258C&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10) [#职场英语](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/search_result?keyword=%25E8%2581%258C%25E5%259C%25BA%25E8%258B%25B1%25E8%25AF%25AD&type=54&source=web_note_detail_r10)
